title: Unit receivable processed successfully
description: Per-item success outcome of a Tangara unit receivable operation, one event per processed item, with operationType selecting the fields. Produced by ur-api, the Tangara unit receivable service, and not by the legacy unit-receivables-api.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key of the item as sent in the request: the UR key for CREATE and UPDATE, the key that identifies the operation for INACTIVATE, the settlement key for CREATE_PAYMENT and CANCEL_PAYMENT

debtor.title: Debtor document number
debtor.description: Document number of the debtor, the party that owes the unit receivable

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Client-assigned reference for the unit receivable

dueDate.title: Due date
dueDate.description: Due date of the unit receivable

originalAssetHolder.title: Original asset holder
originalAssetHolder.description: Document of the original holder of the unit receivable

originalAssetHolderDocumentType.title: Original asset holder document type
originalAssetHolderDocumentType.description: Document type derived from the original asset holder document. [CPF] [CNPJ]

assetHolder.title: Asset holder
assetHolder.description: Document of the current holder of the unit receivable after an assignment

paymentScheme.title: Payment scheme
paymentScheme.description: Payment arrangement code of the unit receivable, free text

prePaidAmount.title: Pre-paid amount
prePaidAmount.description: Pre-paid amount of the unit receivable

bankAccount.title: Bank account
bankAccount.description: Bank domicile of the unit receivable

ispb.title: ISPB
ispb.description: Brazilian Payment System Identifier (ISPB) of the bank, zero-padded to 8 digits

documentNumber.title: Document number
documentNumber.description: Document number of the bank account holder

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: Document type derived from the bank account holder document number. [CPF] [CNPJ]

createdAt.title: Bank account created at
createdAt.description: Timestamp of the first persistence of the bank domicile, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

updatedAt.title: Bank account updated at
updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update of the bank domicile, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Timestamp of the first persistence of the unit receivable, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update of the unit receivable, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

b3RegisteredAt.title: B3 registered at
b3RegisteredAt.description: Value of the request header b3-registered-at, returned unchanged. Omitted when the header is not sent
